meta.title: Add BitmapContext extension methods for direct drawing operations
meta.body_summary: Adds BitmapContext extension methods for direct drawing operations to allow reusing a single context across multiple calls for improved performance.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added BitmapContext extension methods for batch drawing; maintainer asked external contributor for feedback, and design approach is under discussion; no benchmark provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 899 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium addition across 5 files. As a performance-oriented refactor that adds a new class without altering existing public API, it aligns with a moderate incremental improvement, but the PR remains open pending design consensus.

review_details.concern_detail: epsi1on indicated that the PR is not exactly what was requested; the ideal approach would be to replace all WriteableBitmap extension methods with BitmapContext extensions, or at least make WriteableBitmap methods delegate to BitmapContext methods. The current PR adds new parallel methods without refactoring existing ones.
review_details.performance_claim: Reusing a BitmapContext across multiple drawing operations avoids repeated context creation/disposal, improving performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR adds a large set of extension methods following the existing pattern but does not refactor the library to the maintainer's preferred architecture, leading to design discussion and no merge.

detection_detail.code_reading: epsi1on reviewed the addition and suggested a different design approach (either replace all extensions or make WriteableBitmap delegate to BitmapContext).

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or performance measurement provided; only qualitative claim of better performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression occurred; PR not yet merged.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new BitmapContextExtensions class (Source/WriteableBitmapEx/BitmapContextExtensions.cs) with extension methods for drawing lines, rectangles, ellipses, fill methods, blit operations, and transforms directly on a BitmapContext, plus added references in .csproj files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The .csproj files were updated to include the new source file; no behavioral changes in those files.
change_trajectory: Added BitmapContextExtensions with core drawing methods (lines, rectangles, ellipses) and project file updates.

review_signals.summary: Asked epsi1on to review if the new extensions are the wrappers he had in mind.
Noted that the implementation is not completely what was desired; preferred approach is to replace all WriteableBitmap extensions with BitmapContext extensions.
Suggested an alternative approach: duplicate methods where WriteableBitmap extensions delegate to BitmapContext extensions.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with BitmapContext extensions and requested review.
Maintainer reneschulte asked contributor epsi1on for feedback on the design.
epsi1on replied that the approach is not ideal; suggested either replacing all extensions or delegating from WriteableBitmap methods.
Later, epsi1on provided a code example for the delegation approach.
No further activity; PR remains open.
